name: In Vitro Shoujo -Nokosareshi Rakuen no Himegimi-
original_name: 淫靡蕩少女――残されし楽園の姫君――
source:
The protagonist, Hinata, arrives on Kindred Island, known as the last paradise for mankind. His objective is to guard the island's princess, Chiara Tiptree. However, Hinata is actually a spy sent in for a plan to kidnap Princess Chiara, planned to coincide with the island's spirit festival, which is scheduled to take place in a few weeks. 

Chiara welcomes Hinata, but Flavia, who is also a guard, is suspicious of him. Hinata and Chiara are old friends. Moreover, they become aware of each other. When the two meet again as adults, they grow closer, transcending the boundaries between guardian and guarded... What choice will Hinata make in the end?

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240414023727/http://www.waffle1999.com/game/62dlsite3/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公日向来到亲缘岛，这里被称为人类最后的乐园。他的任务是保护岛上的公主琪娅拉·蒂普特里。然而，日向其实是被派来执行绑架琪娅拉计划的间谍；计划安排在几周后举行的岛屿精灵祭典期间实施。

琪娅拉欢迎日向，但同为护卫的弗拉维亚对他心存怀疑。日向与琪娅拉是旧识，而且两人渐渐意识到彼此的感情。当他们以成年人的身份再次相见时，关系超越了守护者与被守护者的界限，变得更加亲密……日向最终会作出怎样的选择？

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240414023727/http://www.waffle1999.com/game/62dlsite3/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
